moves.label: Quick Muscle Jab
moves.description: Fast high wrestler jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact standing punch at upper-body height.

moves.label: Low Leg Sweep
moves.description: Slow low sweep with extended active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low forward leg sweep travels near shin height.

moves.label: Muscle Body Punch
moves.description: Quick mid body punch with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Forward punch lands around the torso.

moves.label: Quick Knee Check
moves.description: Fast mid knee check with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Short knee-lift sequence sits around mid height.

moves.label: Rolling Muscle Press
moves.description: Slow mid rolling body press with a long active crawl and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Kinnikuman rolls forward into a body-first press.

moves.label: Kinniku Lift-Off
moves.description: Slow mid jumping launcher with long active lift and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Jumping knee/body rise is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Muscle Step Kick
moves.description: Quick mid step kick with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Grounded step kick strikes at body height.

moves.label: Low Kinniku Tumble
moves.description: Slow low jumping launcher that tumbles forward and ends crouched.
moves.reason: Low tumbling attack has launcher, jump, and crouch-end data.

moves.label: Kinniku Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow low jumping tornado launcher with extended active spin pressure.
moves.reason: Low forward spin is authored as a tornado launcher.

moves.label: Muscle Spark Tornado
moves.description: Steady mid jumping tornado that knocks down after a strong spinning finish.
moves.reason: Flip into large spinning hit is authored as tornado and knockdown.

moves.label: Crouching Lariat
moves.description: Steady mid crouching lariat with extended active frames and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Low-starting arm swing covers the body line.

moves.label: Crouch Body Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-body punch is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Muscle Jab
moves.description: Quick high overdrive jab with extended active time and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command uses the high punch sequence.

moves.label: Muscle Spark Drive
moves.description: Very slow special knockdown drive with extended active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Long charged rush is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: While-Rising Body Punch
moves.description: Quick mid while-rising punch with extended active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising command uses the mid body punch.

moves.label: Rising Body Splash
moves.description: Slow mid rising body splash with extended active time and short recovery.
moves.reason: Sequence lifts and falls forward like a body splash.

moves.label: Ducking Muscle Jab
moves.description: Quick high ducking jab with extended active time and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the high punch sequence.

moves.label: Diagonal Body Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal body punch is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Muscle Step Rush
moves.description: Fast mid advancing rush with long active body pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command steps through repeated body-rush frames.

moves.label: Forward Body Punch
moves.description: Quick mid forward punch with extended active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the mid body punch.

moves.label: Muscle Rush Jab
moves.description: Quick high rush jab with extended active time and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab keeps the high punch sequence.

moves.label: Kinniku Burst Lariat
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown lariat with long active forward pressure and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Forward burst finishes with a lariat-like swing and knockdown data.
